svg.title: designyourtv
svg.desc: designyourtv: a Google TV's idle screen becomes a painted lock screen with the clock standing behind the painting, and glass widgets that never fake a number. Ten clock faces; each painting is cut into layers once by two small ONNX models run on your own computer; changing painting is a single 1.7-second move. Frames from the repo's own demo: two depth-clock paintings, the dock, and the setup page. Opens github.com/Sohwhat6420/designyourtv.
